```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
# 
library(msa)

# Translate DNA
translate_DNA <- function(dna_data){
  clean_dna <- gsub("[^ACTG]", "", dna_data)
  DNA_strings <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(clean_dna)
  translations <- as.character(Biostrings::translate(DNA_strings))
  return(translations)
}

# Trim CDR3
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}

# Top groups
top_groups <- function(results, clone_var){
  return(table(results[[clone_var]])[order(table(results[[clone_var]]), decreasing = T)])
}

```

## Why are NTGAV, QQGLHDSAGA, and KRTYIGRDY represented multiple times in S19?

First we load the data

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", 
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

# Trim C and W from CDR3s
df$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(df$junction_aa)
```

We will subset clonal groups associated with the CDR3s, and then check their `V` and `J` genes.

```{r}
tmp <- df[df$junction_aa == "NADLLVPYGGLDETD",]
```

**Note:** _"First, sequences are split into groups that share the same V-gene annotation, J-gene annotation, and number of nucleotides in their junction region. Next, these groups are hierarchically clustered based on the nucleotide similarity of their junction quantified by Hamming distance, and partitioned by cutting the dendrogram at a fixed distance threshold."_


```{r}
table(tmp$j_call, tmp$clone_id)
table(tmp$v_call, tmp$clone_id)
```

**V-Genes**

* Clones `3` and `4` share `IGHV3S53*01`, while clone `207` has `IGHVS53*01`. 

* Clone `3` is partitioned into `IGHJ2*01`

* Clone `4` is partitioned into `IGHJ3*01`, `IGHJ4*01`, and `IGHJ6*01`

* Clone `207` is associated solely with `IGHJ4*01`

### Cleanup

```{r}
rm(df, tmp)
```

## Query

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/3_L1_sh3_S3_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", 
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

# df$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(df$junction_aa)
```


```{r}
calculate_levenshtein <- function(query_seq, strings) {
  distances <- adist(query_seq, strings)
  return(distances)
}

library(parallel)

# Set the number of cores to use in parallel
num_cores <- detectCores()

# Specify your query sequence
query_seq <- "AADPWRPGSGWPDEYAY"

# Perform parallel computation of Levenshtein distances
cl <- makeCluster(num_cores)
clusterExport(cl, c("query_seq", "df"))
distances <- parSapply(cl, df$junction_aa, calculate_levenshtein, query_seq)
stopCluster(cl)

# Store the resulting distances
df$query_dist <- as.numeric(distances)

# Percent similarity
df$percent_sim <- 1 - (df$query_dist/nchar(query_seq))
```

## Queries and MSA

1. Take Run S19’s Clones: 
  * `{3x "KRTYIGRDY", 2x "NTGAV", and 2x "YTDYSDYPGGFGS"}`
  * Run MSA on translated VHHs from these clonal families (in S19)
  * De-duplicate before running alignment
  * Remember V-genes, J-genes, clone IDs
  * If there are too many, perform random sampling of ~50-100

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", 
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

# Translate VHHs
df$VHH <- translate_DNA(df$sequence_alignment)
```

## Locate clones of interest

```{r}
tmp <- df[df$junction_aa == "CKRTYIGRDYW",]

tmp <- df[df$clone_id %in% as.numeric(names(table(tmp$clone_id))),]

fails <- tmp[which(grepl("\\*", tmp$VHH, fixed = F)),]
pass <- tmp[which(!grepl("\\*", tmp$VHH, fixed = F)),]
```

```{r}
dedup_pass <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(pass)){
  for (j in 1:pass$duplicate_count[i]){
    dedup_pass <- rbind(dedup_pass, pass[i,])
  }
}
```

For each clone, let's cluster them

```{r}
results <- data.frame()
for (clone_id in unique(dedup_pass$clone_id)){
  tmp_frame <- dedup_pass[dedup_pass$clone_id == clone_id,]
  sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(tmp_frame$VHH)
  # Perform multiple sequence alignment
  msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", verbose = T, order = "input")
  # Store aligned results
  tmp_frame$Aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
}
```

Write file

```{r}
tmp <- results[,c("sequence_id", "v_call", "d_call", "j_call", "clone_id", "Aligned_VHHs")]

write.csv(tmp, file = "~/Downloads/S19-KRTYIGRDYW-all-clones29Feb24.csv", row.names = F)
```

# Functionalize

```{r}
rollout_dupes <- function(pass){
  dedup_pass <- data.frame()
  for (i in 1:nrow(pass)){
    for (j in 1:pass$duplicate_count[i]){
      dedup_pass <- rbind(dedup_pass, pass[i,])
    }
  }
  return(dedup_pass)
}

pull_all_clones <- function(df, cdr_seq, deduplicate = TRUE){
  tmp <- df[df$junction_aa == cdr_seq,]
  tmp <- df[df$clone_id %in% as.numeric(names(table(tmp$clone_id))),]
  if (deduplicate){
    tmp <- tmp[!duplicated(tmp$VHH),]
  } else {
    ## Unroll duplicates
    tmp <- rollout_dupes(tmp[which(!grepl("\\*", tmp$VHH, fixed = F)),])
  }
  return(tmp)
}


run_alignment <- function(dat){
  results <- data.frame()
  for (clone_id in unique(dat$clone_id)){
    # Cluster by clone id
    tmp_frame <- dat[dat$clone_id == clone_id,]
    sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(tmp_frame$VHH)
    # Perform multiple sequence alignment
    msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", verbose = T, order = "input")
    # Store aligned results
    tmp_frame$Aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
    results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
  }
  return(results)
}

write_results <- function(dat, file_folder, consensus_seq, columns){
  tmp <- dat[,columns]
  write.csv(tmp, file = paste(file_folder, consensus_seq, "-clone-alignment02Mar24.csv", sep = ''), row.names = F)
}
```

### Queries

```{r}
queries <- c("CNTGAVW", "CKRTYIGRDYW", "CYTDYSDYPGGFGSW")
```

## Load Data

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", 
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

# Translate VHHs
df$VHH <- translate_DNA(df$sequence_alignment)
```

## Locate clones of interest

```{r}
columns <- c("sequence_id", "v_call", "d_call", "j_call", "clone_id", "Aligned_VHHs")
file_folder <- "~/Downloads/"
consensus_seq <- queries[3]

# Pull clones of interest
tmp <- pull_all_clones(df, consensus_seq, deduplicate = T)

fails <- tmp[which(grepl("\\*", tmp$VHH, fixed = F)),]
pass <- tmp[which(!grepl("\\*", tmp$VHH, fixed = F)),]

results <- run_alignment(pass)

write_results(results, file_folder, consensus_seq, columns)
```
